questions.q: Which statement best summarizes the passage?
options: Tardigrades are soft-bodied insects found only in polar regions
Tardigrades are tiny, widespread micro-animals known for extreme resilience
Tardigrades are extremophiles that thrive best in extreme conditions
Tardigrades are a type of arthropod with a segmented abdomen
questions.explain: The passage describes their anatomy, reproduction, ecology and notable resilience.

questions.q: What did Spallanzani call the tardigrades in 1776?
options: Moss piglets, meaning small moss pigs

questions.q: What are tardigrade stylets made of?
questions.explain: A pair of stylets composed of aragonite pierce the prey.

questions.q: How dense can tardigrades get on mosses?
questions.explain: On mosses they can reach over 2 million per square metre (soil up to 300,000).

questions.q: Why are tardigrades not considered universally extremophilic?
options: They die within seconds in every extreme environment tested
They live only in moss and lichens rather than in the sea
They only endure extreme conditions rather than thrive in them
They cannot survive exposure to outer space or radiation
questions.explain: Their chances of dying rise the longer they are exposed, whereas true extremophiles thrive.
